description: This file defines the XFontFamily class, which represents a group of typefaces with a similar design and style variations. The class includes constructors, methods to retrieve font metrics and styles, and platform-specific code segments for font family creation and handling.

classes.name: XFontFamily
classes.description: Represents a font family with methods to retrieve font metrics and style availability.

methods.name: XFontFamily
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance using a family name.

methods.name: GetCellAscent
methods.description: Returns the cell ascent in design units for a specific font style.

methods.name: GetCellDescent
methods.description: Returns the cell descent in design units for a specific font style.

methods.name: GetEmHeight
methods.description: Returns the em height in design units for a specific font style.

methods.name: GetLineSpacing
methods.description: Returns the line spacing in design units for a specific font style.

methods.name: IsStyleAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether a particular font style is available in the font family.
